Daily Service Rules for Animal Care

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways keeps pet handling steady, calm, and humane from booking through pickup. Staff members check traveler notes, prepare approved supplies, and keep carriers secure and clean. When a pet arrives, the handler speaks softly, keeps movements slow, and uses the least stressful method that fits the animal's needs. Remy or any other pet is never rushed, and food, water, and comfort items are handled with care and respect.

The senior coordinator sets the daily service plan and resolves service questions. <<FACT F017>> Staff use the relief area with care, keep the space tidy, and report any issue at once. If a pet shows signs of stress, the handler pauses the process, gives the animal space, and records the concern in the trip notes. Travelers are told what to expect in plain language, and any special handling request is passed along without delay.

<<FACT F028>> Quarantine use is limited to situations approved by the senior coordinator, and the room stays restricted to trained staff only. Before any animal is placed there, the desk checks paperwork, confirms the reason for the move, and keeps the record current. No one improvises a handoff, and no one leaves a pet unattended in a holding area.

For daily questions or exceptions, contact the senior coordinator through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
